# Vendored demoparser provenance

Source: LaihoE/demoparser commit `ba39cc44cd5abfd7f34df2b3c0a7dd3630048311`.

This vendor contains only the upstream `src/parser` and `src/csgoproto` packages. The 58 MiB fixture and Python, Node, WASM, benchmark, and documentation bindings are excluded. Upstream build scripts were replaced with no-network no-op scripts because generated protobuf and map files are already vendored. The upstream project is MIT licensed; its LICENSE file is preserved in this vendor tree.
